newsitem.title: USA: CVS in talks to acquire Revco - WSJournal.
newsitem.headline: CVS in talks to acquire Revco - WSJournal.

text.p: CVS Corp is in talks to acquire Revco D.S. Inc, but it is not clear whether a deal will be completed, the Wall Street Journal said Monday.
The newspaper quoted people familiar with the situation, saying that talks are beyond the preliminary stages.
If a deal goes through, it would create a drugstore chain with $11 billion in revenues, although CVS may be forced to sell some stores to meet antitrust requirements.
Any merger would be closely looked at by the Federal Trade Commission, which rejected Revco's proposed purchase by Rite Aid, the report said.
A deal would also need the support of Revco co-Chairman Sam Zell, who owns about 20 percent of the company through Zell/Chilmark Fund LP, the paper said.
